claims.text: The hotel is set on the Grand Canal in central Venice, near La Fenice Theatre and Piazza San Marco.

findings.quote: Set on the Grand Canal in the Venice city center near La Fenice Theatre and Piazza San Marco

claims.text: The hotel faces across the Grand Canal to the Salute church.

findings.quote: with its splendid position facing across the Grand Canal to Salute church

claims.text: The palazzo dates to 1475, when the Pisani family gave it its current Gothic shape.

findings.quote: The Gritti Palace dates back to 1475 when the Pisani family, who lived here, transformed it into its current Gothic shape.

claims.text: Rubelli fabrics cover walls and furniture, with Murano chandeliers.

findings.quote: The Rubelli fabrics on walls and furniture positively glow, aided by dazzling Murano chandeliers

claims.text: Rooms feature rare antique furnishings, precious fabrics and Murano glass appliques and chandeliers.

findings.quote: Rare antique furnishings, precious fabrics and Murano glass appliqués and chandeliers are embraced by walls

claims.text: Rooms have Signature Luxury Collection beds, marble bathrooms and Acqua di Parma amenities.

findings.quote: Signature Luxury Collection beds, luxurious marble bathrooms and Acqua di Parma amenities.

claims.text: The Royal Suite holds reminders of former guest Somerset Maugham.

findings.quote: original antiques and reminders of a famous former guest and dear friend - the novelist Somerset Maugham

claims.text: The Gritti SPA is branded by Sisley Paris and offers Phyto-Aromatic treatments.

findings.quote: Experience the luxurious Phyto-Aromatic Treatments at The Gritti SPA, branded by Sisley Paris.

claims.text: The spa has single and double spa suites and a hammam.

findings.quote: The spa, in collaboration with Sisley Paris, has single and double spa suites, a hammam, and aromatherapy treatments.

claims.text: Club del Doge Restaurant sits in a corner position on the Grand Canal and pays tribute to Venetian cuisine.

findings.quote: Exuding the aura of a sophisticated club from its corner position on the Grand Canal, Club del Doge Restaurant is a fresh tribute to the timeless wonders of Venetian cuisine

claims.text: The Gritti Epicurean School is an open kitchen that has hosted wine tastings, culinary workshops and celebrations since 1975.

findings.quote: A Venetian open kitchen that since 1975 has hosted the social elite of Venice and international guests for wine tastings, culinary workshops and celebrations.

claims.text: The Concierge desk is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

findings.quote: The Concierge desk at The Gritti Palace is available 24 hours, 7 days a week.

claims.text: The Redentore Terrazza Suite is a two-storey suite with a 250-square-metre rooftop terrace overlooking Venice and the Grand Canal.

findings.quote: A spectacular two storey suite with a 250 square-meter rooftop terrace and unparalleled views of Venice and the Grand Canal.

claims.text: In 1525 the building became the private residence of the Doge of Venice, Andrea Gritti.

findings.quote: In 1525 the building became the private residence of the Doge of Venice, Andrea Gritti

claims.text: John Ruskin wrote 'The Stones of Venice' during a long stay at Palazzo Gritti with his wife Effie.

findings.quote: John Ruskin and his young wife Effie spent a long period at Palazzo Gritti where he wrote his famous book 'The Stones of Venice'.

claims.text: Riva Yacht Experiences take guests on tailored excursions of the northern and southern lagoons.

findings.quote: Discover the Venetian archipelago’s heritage and the beautiful panoramas of the northern and southern lagoons with our selection of tailored excursions.

claims.text: The Coppa Volpi Heritage Suite honours the Venice International Film Festival, and the Fenice Heritage Suite evokes the opera house.

findings.quote: The Coppa Volpi Heritage Suite honours the Venice International Film Festival, while the Fenice Heritage Suite evokes the spirit of the Opera House.

claims.text: The busy tourist route from the Accademia to Piazza San Marco is just around the corner.

findings.quote: The heavily trafficked tourist route from the Accademia to Piazza San Marco is just around the corner

claims.text: High tide (acqua alta) occurs more often in autumn and winter, when sea water partly covers some areas of the city.

findings.quote: High tide occurs more frequently during autumn and winter when the sea water partially covers some areas of the city.

claims.text: Rooms do not permit rollaway beds.

findings.quote: No, the rooms at The Gritti Palace, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Venice do not permit rollaway beds.
